Immune phenotype rules used by the feature script
  • immune-desert: very low total TIL area, below the configured desert threshold.
  • immune-penetrated: intratumoral TIL fraction is at least 0.30 by default.
  • margin-localized: at least 50% of TIL area lies within 50 µm of the tumour boundary by default.
  • immune-excluded: extratumoral median distance is at least 100 µm by default.
  • peritumoral: extratumoral median distance is below 100 µm when other rules do not dominate.

Necrosis phenotype rules used by the feature script
  • necrosis-absent: total necrosis area is below the configured absent threshold, 500 µm² by default.
  • tumour-central: intratumoral necrosis fraction is at least 0.50 by default.
  • peritumoural: at least 60% of necrosis area is within 100 µm of tumour boundary by default.
  • immune-adjacent: immune coupling index is at least 0.20 by default.
  • stromal-distant: assigned when necrosis is present but the other proximity patterns do not dominate.

Morphology interpretation guardrails
  • All morphology scales are area-weighted across tumour-positive clusters unless the metric is a total count or total area.
  • Fragmentation index, spread fraction, solidity, compactness, and largest-patch index live on natural 0–1 scales.
  • Elongation starts at 1, where 1 means round/isotropic; higher values indicate elongated tumour islands.

Computational summaries are derived from segmentation features. They are descriptive only and are not a standalone diagnosis.
